patch_list: Stops Advanced Security from uploading the websites it checked and your network changes. Threat filtering on the phone keeps working. Opt-in; test on-device.
Stops Comcast's own event tracking, Datadog, Medallia surveys, Branch, and Firebase Analytics. Sign-in, bill pay, and WiFi management are left alone. Opt-in; test on-device.
Turns off the Xfinity Assistant chat. Some support and troubleshooting steps that open the Assistant may stop working. Opt-in; test on-device.

Gives the app a random per-install Android ID instead of your device's, and reports a zeroed advertising ID with ad tracking limited, as if you had deleted your ad ID in Android settings. The video DRM ID is left alone so playback works. O…
